CIV.note: Procurement notice; nothing on AI harms.
AI expertise is only a bidder qualification; no AI system in use stated.
Nothing on AI built in the country.
Sovereign hosting and data location are only requirements to be mapped by the consultant; no rule stated.

facts.fact: The World Bank-financed PADCI procurement notice requires the barometer design to respect the applicable provisions of law no. 2013-450 on personal data protection.

CIV.note: Sovereign hosting is a requirement to be mapped for one platform; no state data rule, hosting or contract terms stated.
WCAG tests are a validation step for one platform; no accessibility rule stated.
The portal is named with no service count, sign-in or use figures.

facts.fact: The notice refers to the interoperability and security reference framework provided for by decrees no. 2021-911 to 2021-916.
facts.system: referentiel d'interoperabilite et de securite (decrees 2021-911 to 2021-916)

CIV.note: The framework is not said to set technical standards.
